title: 2381. Shifting Letters II

examples.explanation: Firstly, shift the characters from index 0 to index 1 backward. Now s = "zac". Secondly, shift the characters from index 1 to index 2 forward. Now s = "zbd". Finally, shift the characters from index 0 to index 2 forward. Now s = "ace".
Firstly, shift the characters from index 0 to index 0 backward. Now s = "cztz". Finally, shift the characters from index 1 to index 1 forward. Now s = "catz".
